title: Unit 12: Travellers' Tales: Travel, Transport & Relative Clauses
objective: Mampu menceritakan pengalaman hidup dan perjalanan menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, membedakannya dengan Past Simple, serta menggunakan kata kerja transportasi dan perjalanan dengan tepat

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menceritakan pengalaman hidup menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, terutama untuk kejadian yang sudah terjadi di masa lalu tetapi masih relevan dengan masa kini. Kamu juga akan belajar perbedaan antara Present Perfect dan Past Simple, serta penggunaan ever/never untuk menanyakan dan menceritakan pengalaman.
rules: Present Perfect Simple: I/you/we/they + have + past participle | Contoh: I have travelled to many countries. (Pengalaman yang masih relevan)
Present Perfect Simple: he/she/it + has + past participle | Contoh: She has been to Indonesia three times.
Present Perfect dengan ever: Have you ever eaten snake? (Pernahkah kamu...?) | Jawaban: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Present Perfect dengan never: I have never seen a snake. (Saya belum pernah melihat ular)
Past Simple untuk kejadian di waktu tertentu di masa lalu: She travelled to Paris last year. | Present Perfect untuk pengalaman tanpa waktu spesifik: She has travelled to Paris.

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering salah menggunakan Past Simple ketika seharusnya menggunakan Present Perfect, atau sebaliknya. Gunakan Present Perfect ketika TIDAK menyebutkan waktu spesifik dan fokus pada pengalaman/hasil. Gunakan Past Simple ketika menyebutkan KAPAN kejadian terjadi.
commonTrap.wrong: I have visited London last year. / Have you seen the movie yesterday?
commonTrap.correct: I visited London last year. / Did you see the movie yesterday? ATAU I have visited London. (tanpa waktu spesifik)

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Steve Anderson dan murid-murid sekolahnya tentang pengalaman perjalanannya

lines.speaker: Student 1
lines.text: What's the most interesting place you've been to?
lines.translation: Apa tempat paling menarik yang pernah kamu kunjungi?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I've been to India. It was amazing!
lines.translation: Saya pernah ke India. Itu luar biasa!

lines.speaker: Student 2
lines.text: Where did you eat a cooked spider?
lines.translation: Di mana kamu makan laba-laba yang dimasak?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: In Mexico. I ate it at a street market.
lines.translation: Di Meksiko. Saya memakannya di pasar jalanan.

lines.speaker: Student 3
lines.text: Have you ever had any accidents?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Yes, I have. I had an accident in a minibus once.
lines.translation: Ya, pernah. Saya pernah mengalami kecelakaan di minibus.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalaman perjalanan dan transportasi yang pernah kamu gunakan

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about your travel experiences. Have you ever been to another country?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have. I've been to Malaysia. / No, I haven't. I've never been abroad.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! What kinds of transport have you used? Have you ever taken a train?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have. I took a train to Yogyakarta last year. / No, I haven't. I've never taken a train.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great! Now, have you ever tried any unusual food when you travelled?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have. I tried durian in Medan. / No, I haven't tried anything unusual.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! You're doing very well with the present perfect. Keep practicing!

quiz.question: Which sentence uses Present Perfect correctly?
options: I have visited Bali last month.
I have visited Bali many times.
quiz.answer: I have visited Bali many times.
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect digunakan untuk pengalaman tanpa waktu spesifik. Kalimat 'I have visited Bali many times' benar karena tidak menyebutkan kapan tepatnya. Kalimat dengan 'last month' atau 'yesterday' harus menggunakan Past Simple.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: '_____ you ever _____ snake?'
quiz.explanation: Untuk menanyakan pengalaman dengan 'ever', gunakan Present Perfect: Have + subject + ever + past participle. Bentuk past participle dari 'eat' adalah 'eaten'.

quiz.question: Which is the correct response to 'Have you ever been to Japan?'
options: Yes, I went there last year.
Yes, I have been there yesterday.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban singkat untuk pertanyaan Present Perfect adalah 'Yes, I have' atau 'No, I haven't'. Meskipun 'Yes, I went there last year' secara makna benar, format jawaban singkat yang tepat adalah 'No, I haven't'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: She has travelled to Thailand in 2020.
She have travelled to Thailand in 2020.
quiz.explanation: Ketika ada waktu spesifik seperti 'in 2020', gunakan Past Simple, bukan Present Perfect. Jadi 'She travelled to Thailand in 2020' adalah yang benar.

quiz.question: What is the past participle of 'go'?
quiz.explanation: Past participle dari 'go' adalah 'gone' (irregular verb). 'Went' adalah past simple, bukan past participle. Contoh: I have gone to Bali. / I went to Bali yesterday.

quiz.question: Complete: 'I have _____ been to Australia. I really want to go there!'
quiz.explanation: 'Never' digunakan dalam Present Perfect untuk menyatakan belum pernah melakukan sesuatu. Kalimat 'I have never been to Australia' berarti 'Saya belum pernah ke Australia', yang cocok dengan konteks 'I really want to go there'.
